held_target_d04_resume.question: does adding a NEW module under src/compose_v4/experiments/ break the resume-time validation of the four live delta=0.4 arms
held_target_d04_resume.method: recomputed every pinned runtime_inputs_sha256 of all four live d04 contracts before and after creating a probe module, then deleted the probe
held_target_d04_resume.status: PROVEN for the validation gate: _validate_task hashes runtime_inputs PER FILE, and no pinned file changes.
held_target_d04_resume.still_inferred: that Modal's image rebuild and container resume behave normally otherwise. That cannot be tested without launching against a live arm, so it stays INFERRED rather than rounded up.

shared_controller_capsule.question: which capsule manifests does a _VARIANT_APPS entry invalidate
shared_controller_capsule.method: hashed modal_apps/t4_shared_controller_completion_v1_app.py before and after inserting a variant entry, then restored the file byte-for-byte
shared_controller_capsule.correction: an earlier estimate said FIVE shared-controller variants would be invalidated. Measured, only ONE manifest currently matches the launcher on disk; the other six already pin superseded versions and are therefore already un-relaunchable, so the change costs them nothing.

conclusion: the change is materially safer than estimated: it provably moves no pinned input of any live delta=0.4 arm, and it invalidates exactly one capsule manifest, belonging to a campaign that is not running.
